# HemoSmart — Experiment: adding WHO's 2021 educational modules to the RAG corpus

**Experiment only; production is unchanged.** Same pipeline as production (section-aware 500-char chunks, MiniLM, FAISS top 20 + cross-encoder rerank). Chunks: 2001 handbook 797, 2021 modules 1221. Generated by `python -m evaluation.rag_2021_experiment` on 2026-11-01 23:22.

A hit needs the labelled (document, page). Question sets are frozen: `rag_eval_set.json` (D88, sha256 `6d064d8b5ef9…`) and `rag_eval_set_2021.json` (sha256 `02dc4d542a46…`, written before this experiment first ran).

## Reading the 2001-set drop (post hoc, not a metric)

The 2001 set credits only 2001 pages. Of the 7 test questions production answers at rank 1 but the combined corpus does not, the combined top hit is a 2021 page that answers the question in 4 (q06 red cell concentrate p.54; q20 and q21 cryoprecipitate p.59; q44 obstetric haemorrhage pp.139–140), partly in 2 (q09 platelets p.60 gives post-pooling time, not storage; q32 p.68 gives donor screening, not the tests) and not in 1 (q01 adult Hb threshold, p.115 is the malaria section). Judged after seeing the results, so it explains the drop rather than replacing the frozen score.

## Numeric thresholds stated in the 2021 modules (PDF pages)

- Red cells, adults (p.44): Hb < 7 g/dl for stable hospitalized adults incl. critically ill; 7.5 g/dl cardiac surgery; 8 g/dl orthopaedic surgery or stable cardiovascular disease; 7 g/dl acute upper GI bleed; transfusion rarely indicated above 10 g/dl.
- Red cells, children (p.44) and neonates (p.150): < 7 g/dl stable critically ill children; 7–10 g/dl with acute brain injury; neonatal table by respiratory support (Hb ≤ 7–10 g/dl).
- Anaemia definitions (p.29: men < 13, non-pregnant women < 12 g/dl; p.132: pregnancy < 11 / 10.5 g/dl by trimester) -- definitions, explicitly not transfusion triggers.
- Platelets (p.165, Box 7.4, children; 'based on adult literature'): prophylaxis ≤ 10 × 10⁹/L stable, ≤ 20 with bleeding risk; bleeding ≤ 10 / 30 / 50 (minor / moderate / severe), ≤ 100 at a critical site; lumbar puncture ≤ 40; liver biopsy and other surgery ≤ 50; minor surgery ≤ 20. Neonates ≤ 25 (NAIT ≤ 30). Expected increment per adult dose 15–40 × 10⁹/L (pp.60, 101).
- Plasma/INR (p.174): correct INR to < 2.0 before surgery (vitamin K 0.5 mg IV if surgery can wait ≥ 6 h, otherwise plasma up to 15 ml/kg); plasma initial dose 15–20 ml/kg (p.58). DIC: platelets < 50 × 10⁹/L (p.142).
- No adult platelet table outside the paediatric box, and no INR > 1.5 trigger for FFP.

## Explanations: not yet run

The explanation comparison (10 cases × 2 runs × 2 corpora = 40 Groq calls, ~200k tokens) needs about one full day of Groq's free-tier token budget (200k tokens/day, shared with the app). 7 of 40 explanations are cached in `evaluation/results/rag_2021_experiment_explanations.json`; `python -m evaluation.rag_2021_experiment --llm` resumes from there.
